'''{{PAGENAME}}''' was a [[Quests|Quest]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Dialogue==
{{quote|Hey there, come in. Well, as you can see, it's rough times now, you can trust nobody. There are traitors and moles in every corner possible, but as far as I can see you are a good soldier, proven in action, so I can count on you. Now, I need to send some info from time to time and I need an appropriate person for this, someone who's trusted not only by me but by everyone else too. Speak with other traders, earn their trust. Will be beneficial for both of us.}}

==Requirements==
* Must be level 35 to start this quest.

==Objectives==
* Reach Loyalty Level 4 with [[Ragman]]
* Reach Loyalty Level 4 with [[Skier]]
* Reach Loyalty Level 4 with [[Mechanic]]
* Reach Loyalty Level 4 with [[Peacekeeper]]
* Reach Loyalty Level 4 with [[Prapor]]
* Reach Loyalty Level 4 with [[Therapist]]
* Reach Loyalty Level 4 with [[Jaeger]]

==Rewards==
* +20,900 [[EXP]]
* [[Prapor]] Rep <font color="green">'''+0.02'''</font>
* 55,000 Roubles
** 57,750 Roubles with [[Hideout#Modules|Intelligence Center]] Level 1
** 63,250 Roubles with [[Hideout#Modules|Intelligence Center]] Level 2
* 1× [[T H I C C Weapon case]]
* Unlocks purchase of [[SR-3M 9x39 compact assault rifle]] at [[Prapor]] LL4
{{quote|Now we're talking! Now I know for sure that I have the right person to work with, and I can be sure that everything gets delivered where it's supposed to. Here's a little present from me, in honor of our cooperation.}}
